description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {1}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
